title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit325, int4 KV, 1M context, DFlash2 drafter
summary: Full GLM-5.3 on four DGX Sparks at TP=4 with gr8 v1.1.0: exlr8 bit325 (v0.6), int4 KV with a 1,130,496-token pool and 1,048,576 max context, zero-copy shared prefix pages, DFlash2 + MTP=2 drafting, eight bit-exact kernel paths plus MoE union cap (48 quality default, 32 fast preset), up to 8 concurrent chats, and a persistent SSD KV store. Live-proven at 3x300K, 4x153K, and 8x26K shared prefix.

configs.label: TP=3
configs.notes: bit225 experts (2.25 bpw), MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, mean of two fresh boots, GPU clocks uncapped, measured 2026-10-24 with the launcher defaults of that date.

configs.label: TP=4
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: prompt + max_tokens · live-proven: 3x300K (899K resident), 4x153K (614K resident), 8x26K shared prefix
configs.notes: bit325 experts (3.25 bpw, v0.6 @ 3e388b45), int4 KV (CAP=1,130,496, 4,800 pages/rank, MAX_MODEL_LEN=1,048,576, SHARE_LIMIT=32,768, SESS=8, GR8_KV_SHARE_PAGES=1), DFlash2 + MTP=2 (DFL_REUSE_MIN=0, L2PF=31, MTP_L2PF=3, MTP_LASTROW=1, DRAFT_HEAD2=1, PF_GEMMF32=1), gr8 v1.1.0 (8 bit-exact kernels ON, DEC_BK_MAX=2048, MOE_UNION_CAP=48 quality default; set MOE_UNION_CAP=32 for fast mode: 74.6 tok/s code, 101.0 tok/s at C=4, 149.1 tok/s at C=8). bench/bench.py default level on 2026-11-20, one fresh boot on a 200G switch, GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages. Lowest MemAvailable: 5.39 GiB after bench, 5.00 GiB after 899K-token live concurrency proofs.

configs.label: TP=5
configs.notes: bit325 experts (3.25 bpw, v0.6 @ 3e388b45), int4 KV (CAP=983,040, SESS=8), MTP=3 with confidence stopping, gr8 v1.1.0, MOE_UNION_CAP=48 quality default (32 fast: 119.6 at C=4, 160.5 at C=8). bench/bench.py default level on 2026-11-20; see glm-5.3-exlr8-5x-spark.

configs.label: TP=6
configs.notes: home experts (3.25 bpw), MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, mean of two fresh boots, GPU clocks uncapped, measured 2026-10-24 with the launcher defaults of that date. One of the six boxes was capped at 2200 MHz.
